title: Reception - Chester
description:
Exciting Temporary Reception Opportunity in Chester!

Title: Receptionist

Pay rate: 14.00 an hour

Working hours: 10am to 4pm

Duration: Temporary adhoc weekend work

Are you a friendly and professional individual with a passion for customer service? Our client, a leading player in the automotive industry, is seeking an enthusiastic Receptionist to join their dynamic team in Chester. This temporary position offers a fantastic opportunity to gain experience within a thriving organisation while showcasing your exceptional communication skills.

Key Responsibilities:
- Greet and assist visitors with a warm and welcoming demeanour.
- Manage incoming calls and direct them to the appropriate departments.
- Handle inquiries and provide information about the organisation's services.
- Maintain an orderly reception area, ensuring it reflects a professional image.
- Assist with administrative tasks as required, including data entry and filing.
- Collaborate with team members to ensure smooth operations.

What Our Client Offers:
- A vibrant work environment within a renowned automotive organisation.
- Opportunities to develop skills and gain valuable experience in a fast-paced setting.
- Competitive hourly rate and flexible working hours.
- The chance to be part of a supportive team that values every member.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

Our client is looking for someone who possesses:
- Previous experience in a reception or customer service role.
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
- A friendly and approachable personality, with a knack for making visitors feel welcome.
- Proficiency in using standard office software and phone systems.
- The ability to multitask and prioritise effectively in a busy environment.
- A proactive attitude and a willingness to help others.

Location:

This exciting role is based in Hough Green, Chester, easily accessible by public transport and with ample parking available.

Why This Role?

If you thrive in a vibrant environment and enjoy being the first point of contact for clients and visitors, this opportunity is perfect for you! Our client values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

How to Apply:

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply promptly! Please submit your CV. Don't miss the chance to be part of a fantastic team and contribute to the success of a leading automotive organisation.

This temporary Receptionist position in Chester promises to be an engaging experience where you can make a significant impact. If you have a passion for delivering excellent service and want to be part of a lively team, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

Apply today and step into a role that offers both challenges and rewards in a friendly, professional atmosphere. Your next career adventure awaits!

title: Data & Research Administrator
description:
Key Responsibilities:
- Provide day-to-day administrative and data support to the Investment/Research team, acting as an assistant to colleagues across a range of recurring and ad hoc tasks.
- Extract data from internal and external sources and prepare it for use in reporting, analysis and operational processes.
- Clean, organise, reconcile and manipulate data in Excel, including combining datasets, identifying inconsistencies and resolving data-quality issues.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records, databases, spreadsheets and reporting tools, ensuring information is complete, consistent and available when required.
- Produce regular and ad hoc reports, schedules and data summaries for internal stakeholders, following established templates and procedures.
- Carry out data checks and reconciliations, investigate exceptions and follow up missing or inaccurate information with the appropriate team members.
- Review existing administrative and data processes, identify inefficiencies or control gaps, and suggest practical improvements to make processes more accurate, consistent and efficient.

Skills & Experience:
- Advanced Excel skills are essential, with confidence using formulas, lookups, PivotTables, filters, sorting and other tools to extract, clean and manipulate data.
- Strong numerical and analytical ability, with the confidence to work with large volumes of data and identify errors, trends and inconsistencies.
- Experience in a data administration, reporting, operations, record-keeping or similar support role is preferred; financial services experience is useful but not essential.
- No specific finance degree or professional finance qualification is required; practical data-handling ability, accuracy and strong Excel skills are more important.
- Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time-management skills, with a methodical approach to maintaining records and completing recurring tasks.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to ask questions, follow up information and work effectively with colleagues across the business.

Key Attributes:
- Highly organised, dependable and comfortable working in a support-focused role with multiple routine and ad hoc priorities.
- Methodical and data-focused, with a strong commitment to accuracy, completeness and good record keeping.
- Curious about how processes work and willing to question, document and improve existing ways of working.
- Collaborative and service-oriented, with a practical approach to supporting the wider team and meeting deadlines.

title: Casualty Claims Handler
description:
A renowned National Loss Adjusting Organisation are now seeking an experienced Liability Claims Handler to join their specialist Casualty Liability Team.
- You will handle a variety of specialist Liability claims on behalf of a number of Public Sector clients.
- You will manage and be responsible for your own caseload of losses, being part of a dedicated team you will play a vital part of the business by providing an exceptional claims service to key clients.
- Due to growth and expansion this will be an exciting time to join where you will be offered the opportunity to progress and develop long-term.

Key responsibilities:
- Handle a variety of casualty/personal injury claims through to settlement
- Verify policy cover/validity
- Log and record all claims digitally
- Investigate allocated claims either from desk or instructed by the team of loss adjusters
- Where appropriate refer to a field adjuster for site investigation to establish how the loss occurred
- Gather all necessary evidence and relevant documentation
- Determine appropriate action for resolution
- Make decision on liability and negotiate settlement where appropriate
- Keep up to date with any technical changes within the industry and to your role which may involve participating in training programmes within the company

About you:
- Liability/Casualty Claims handling experience working in the Loss Adjusting, Insurance or Legal Sector
- Experience of handling your caseload of claims through to settlement
- The ability to value an injury loss
- Experience of handling defendant losses
- The ability or understand insurance policy wordings and the insurance market
- Knowledge of civil procedure rules and the claims portal
- Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
- Good planning and organisational skills
- Solid IT skills and be able to use multiple in-house systems
- Insurance Industry Qualifications or working towards desirable

Benefits on Offer:
- Remote or hybrid depending on location, 35 hours per week Monday to Friday
- Flexible benefits including holiday purchase plan and the opportunity to purchase health cash and BUPA dental plan, flexible working, 5% pension, life assurance 4 x, enhanced maternity, paternity, and adoption pay, discounts with UK retailers, wellbeing hub and many more

title: Onboarding Care Coordinator
description:
On-boarding Care Coordinator (Care Pro Lead)

Brand-New Role Mileage paid at up to 45p per mile Guaranteed 37.5 hours per week

Are you an experienced Care Professional ready for a fresh challenge where you can make a real impact from day one?

Home Instead is launching an exciting new role and we're looking for a passionate, people-focused Onboarding Care Coordinator (Care Pro Lead) to support new clients through the first 30 days of their care journey.

This is a unique opportunity to combine hands-on care, client onboarding, mentoring, and relationship-building, helping clients and their families feel reassured, supported, and confident from the very start.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

This position has the benefit of a contract with 37.5 guaranteed hours per week as part of an innovative pilot programme across the Home Instead network.

This means you can enjoy the excitement of helping shape a brand-new role while benefiting from long-term career opportunities within Home Instead.

The Role

As the trusted face of Home Instead for new clients, you will:
- Support clients and their families throughout the first 30 days of care.
- Build strong relationships and confidence from the outset.
- Help establish routines and successfully implement personalised care plans.
- Ensure a smooth transition to their longer-term Care Professional team.
- Provide guidance, coaching, and mentoring to colleagues.
- Champion Home Instead's person-centred approach and high standards of care.
- Help reduce waiting times for new clients and ensure an exceptional onboarding experience.

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- An experienced Care Professional with a proven track record of delivering outstanding person-centred care.
- Qualified in Health & Social Care (NVQ/QCF or equivalent).
- A confident communicator with excellent relationship-building skills.
- Passionate about supporting, coaching, and developing others.
- In possession of an Enhanced DBS check and the Right to Work in the UK.
- A driver with a full UK driving licence and access to a vehicle (where required).

Why Join Home Instead?

This is the first Onboarding Care Coordinator role to be introduced within the Home Instead network, giving you the chance to help shape an exciting new position while working for an award-winning care provider.

If you're passionate about delivering exceptional care, supporting people through important life transitions, and want to play a key role in an innovative new approach, we'd love to hear from you.
